description: This Java class 'ThreadSnapshotParser' parses thread stack traces from VM traces, extracting thread info, stack frames, and lock states.

classes.name: ThreadSnapshotParser
classes.description: A parser for VM trace thread stack traces, capable of extracting thread details, stack frames, and lock information.
